Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely compiled an incomplete list from a non-exhaustive summary and concluded there were only five countries. It ignored Jordan mentioned in the summary and failed to verify the full set of Asian monarchies with coastlines (e.g., also missing Oman, Qatar, Kuwait, UAE, Malaysia, and Cambodia). This lack of comprehensive cross-checking against Wikipedia’s full list led to the undercount; the correct number is 12.
